```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step X. Mechanistic dissection of CNL 8d-down repression
##  H1: tissue senescence (correlate with SAGs)
##  H2: SA/JA-coupled feedback (correlate with SA/JA markers)
##  H3: generic transcriptional decline (correlate with HK genes)
############################################################


outdir_cnl <- analysis_file("CNL_8d_down_mechanism")
dir.create(outdir_cnl, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


## -----------------------------
## 1. Identify CNL 8d-down genes
## -----------------------------

cnl_8d_down <- nlr_lfc %>%
  filter(
    Type == "CNL",
    DE_LRT == TRUE,
    as.character(main_response_time) %in% c("8d", "8", "8.0"),
    direction_at_max == "down_at_max"
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

cat("CNL 8d-down genes:", length(cnl_8d_down), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 2. Build marker gene sets from eggNOG
## -----------------------------

# SA / JA pathway markers
hormone_markers <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("ko04075|ko00592", KEGG_Pathway)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique()

# Senescence-associated genes via leaf/organ senescence GO terms
sag_markers <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("GO:0010150|GO:0010260|GO:0090693", GOs)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique()

# Housekeeping control: ribosome (KEGG ko03010)
hk_markers <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("ko03010", KEGG_Pathway)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique()

cat(sprintf(
  "Marker counts - SA/JA: %d, SAG: %d, HK control: %d\n",
  length(hormone_markers), length(sag_markers), length(hk_markers)
))


## -----------------------------
## 3. Per-CNL mean Spearman correlation with each marker set
## -----------------------------

cnl_in_expr <- intersect(cnl_8d_down, rownames(expr_matrix))

compute_mean_cor <- function(cnl_genes, marker_genes, expr_mat) {
  marker_in_expr <- intersect(marker_genes, rownames(expr_mat))
  if (length(cnl_genes) == 0 || length(marker_in_expr) < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, length(cnl_genes)))
  cor_mat <- cor(
    t(expr_mat[cnl_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
    t(expr_mat[marker_in_expr, , drop = FALSE]),
    method = "spearman"
  )
  rowMeans(cor_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
}

cnl_cor_summary <- tibble(
  Gene           = cnl_in_expr,
  cor_with_SA_JA = compute_mean_cor(cnl_in_expr, hormone_markers, expr_matrix),
  cor_with_SAG   = compute_mean_cor(cnl_in_expr, sag_markers,     expr_matrix),
  cor_with_HK    = compute_mean_cor(cnl_in_expr, hk_markers,      expr_matrix)
)

write_tsv(cnl_cor_summary,
          file.path(outdir_cnl, "CNL_8d_down_marker_correlations.tsv"))

cat("\n===== Summary of marker-set correlations =====\n")
print(summary(cnl_cor_summary[, -1]))


## -----------------------------
## 4. Boxplot + violin
## -----------------------------

cor_long <- cnl_cor_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "MarkerSet", values_to = "MeanSpearman") %>%
  mutate(MarkerSet = recode(MarkerSet,
    cor_with_SA_JA = "SA/JA pathway",
    cor_with_SAG   = "Senescence (SAG)",
    cor_with_HK    = "Ribosome (HK)"
  ))

p_cor <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = MarkerSet, y = MeanSpearman, fill = MarkerSet)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "SA/JA pathway"    = "#D62728",
    "Senescence (SAG)" = "#FF7F0E",
    "Ribosome (HK)"    = "#7F7F7F"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = "CNL 8d-down genes: correlation with three marker sets",
    subtitle = sprintf("n = %d CNL 8d-down genes", nrow(cnl_cor_summary)),
    x = NULL, y = "Mean Spearman correlation per CNL gene"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_cor)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_cnl, "CNL_8d_down_marker_correlation_boxplot.pdf"),
       p_cor, width = 6.5, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_cnl, "CNL_8d_down_marker_correlation_boxplot.png"),
       p_cor, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Wilcoxon paired tests
## -----------------------------

cat("\n===== Wilcoxon paired tests (per-CNL correlations) =====\n")
cat("SA/JA vs SAG:", with(cnl_cor_summary,
  wilcox.test(cor_with_SA_JA, cor_with_SAG, paired = TRUE))$p.value, "\n")
cat("SA/JA vs HK :", with(cnl_cor_summary,
  wilcox.test(cor_with_SA_JA, cor_with_HK,  paired = TRUE))$p.value, "\n")
cat("SAG   vs HK :", with(cnl_cor_summary,
  wilcox.test(cor_with_SAG,   cor_with_HK,  paired = TRUE))$p.value, "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 6. Heatmap (CNL 8d-down + top markers, VST z-score)
## -----------------------------

top_marker_each <- function(marker_genes, n = 10) {
  m <- intersect(marker_genes, rownames(expr_matrix))
  if (length(m) < 2) return(character(0))
  med_cor <- sapply(m, function(g) {
    median(cor(expr_matrix[g, ],
               t(expr_matrix[cnl_in_expr, , drop = FALSE]),
               method = "spearman"), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  names(sort(abs(med_cor), decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(n, length(m))]
}

top_SA_JA <- top_marker_each(hormone_markers, 10)
top_SAG   <- top_marker_each(sag_markers, 10)

heat_genes <- intersect(c(cnl_in_expr, top_SA_JA, top_SAG), rownames(expr_matrix))
annotation_row <- data.frame(
  GeneType = c(
    rep("CNL 8d-down", sum(cnl_in_expr %in% heat_genes)),
    rep("SA/JA marker", sum(top_SA_JA %in% heat_genes)),
    rep("SAG marker",   sum(top_SAG   %in% heat_genes))
  ),
  row.names = heat_genes
)

pheatmap(
  expr_matrix[heat_genes, ],
  scale = "row", cluster_cols = FALSE, show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  main = "CNL 8d-down vs SA/JA & SAG markers (VST z-score)"
)

pheatmap(
  expr_matrix[heat_genes, ],
  scale = "row", cluster_cols = FALSE, show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  main = "CNL 8d-down vs SA/JA & SAG markers (VST z-score)",
  filename = file.path(outdir_cnl, "CNL_8d_down_vs_markers_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 7, height = 9
)
```
```{r}
sa_core_kos <- c("K14508",  # NPR1/NPR3/NPR4 (SA receptor)
                 "K13449",  # PR1 (SA marker)
                 "K13435",  # TGA (SA TF)
                 "K20712")  # ICS1/SID2 (SA biosynthesis)

ja_core_kos <- c("K14509",  # JAR1 (JA-Ile conjugation)
                 "K13464",  # COI1 (JA receptor)
                 "K13463",  # JAZ (JA repressor)
                 "K17760",  # MYC2 (JA TF)
                 "K18021")  # LOX2/3/4 (JA biosynthesis)

sa_markers_strict <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(paste(sa_core_kos, collapse = "|"), KEGG_ko)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique()

ja_markers_strict <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(paste(ja_core_kos, collapse = "|"), KEGG_ko)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique()

cat("Strict SA core markers:", length(sa_markers_strict), "\n")
cat("Strict JA core markers:", length(ja_markers_strict), "\n")

# SA: GO:0009751 response to salicylic acid
# JA: GO:0009753 response to jasmonic acid
if (length(sa_markers_strict) < 5) {
  sa_markers_strict <- anno %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("GO:0009751|GO:0009697", GOs)) %>%
    pull(Gene) %>% unique()
  cat("Fallback SA via GO:", length(sa_markers_strict), "\n")
}
if (length(ja_markers_strict) < 5) {
  ja_markers_strict <- anno %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("GO:0009753|GO:0009695", GOs)) %>%
    pull(Gene) %>% unique()
  cat("Fallback JA via GO:", length(ja_markers_strict), "\n")
}

cnl_in_expr <- intersect(cnl_8d_down, rownames(expr_matrix))
compute_mean_cor <- function(target, marker_genes, mat) {
  m <- intersect(marker_genes, rownames(mat))
  if (length(m) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  rowMeans(cor(t(mat[target, , drop = FALSE]),
               t(mat[m,      , drop = FALSE]),
               method = "spearman"), na.rm = TRUE)
}
cnl_strict <- tibble(
  Gene = cnl_in_expr,
  cor_SA = compute_mean_cor(cnl_in_expr, sa_markers_strict, expr_matrix),
  cor_JA = compute_mean_cor(cnl_in_expr, ja_markers_strict, expr_matrix)
)
print(summary(cnl_strict[, -1]))

cnl_strict %>% dplyr::filter(Gene == "Pt5G50680") %>% print()

focus_pair <- c("Pt5G50680", "Pt6G26210")
focus_cor <- tibble(
  Gene = focus_pair,
  cor_SA_strict = compute_mean_cor(focus_pair, sa_markers_strict, expr_matrix),
  cor_JA_strict = compute_mean_cor(focus_pair, ja_markers_strict, expr_matrix)
)
print(focus_cor)
```
```{r}
sa_vec <- colMeans(expr_matrix[intersect(sa_markers_strict, rownames(expr_matrix)), ])
ja_vec <- colMeans(expr_matrix[intersect(ja_markers_strict, rownames(expr_matrix)), ])
cnl_vec <- colMeans(expr_matrix[intersect(cnl_8d_down, rownames(expr_matrix)), ])

z <- function(x) (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)

cross_df <- tibble(
  Sample = colnames(expr_matrix),
  SA_zscore  = z(sa_vec),
  JA_zscore  = z(ja_vec),
  CNL_zscore = z(cnl_vec)
) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>% rownames_to_column("Sample") %>% dplyr::select(Sample, time),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(SA_zscore, JA_zscore, CNL_zscore),
               names_to = "Track", values_to = "z") %>%
  mutate(
    Track = recode(Track,
                   SA_zscore  = "SA pathway markers (n=22)",
                   JA_zscore  = "JA pathway markers (n=77)",
                   CNL_zscore = "CNL 8d-down (n=61)"),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("0d","2d","5d","8d"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Track, time) %>%
  summarise(z_mean = mean(z), z_sd = sd(z), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(cross_df, aes(x = time, y = z_mean, color = Track, group = Track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = z_mean - z_sd, ymax = z_mean + z_sd),
                width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "SA pathway markers (n=22)" = "#D62728",
    "JA pathway markers (n=77)" = "#FF7F0E",
    "CNL 8d-down (n=61)"        = "#1F77B4"
  )) +
  labs(title    = "Reciprocal expression: CNL surveillance pool vs hormone defense",
       subtitle = "Strict SA/JA core markers; mean z-scored VST +/- SD",
       x = "Time post-inoculation",
       y = "Mean z-scored expression",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
